entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: 192 aa soluble protein; predicted molecular mass 21.17 kDa and theoretical pI 5.17.
Contains a Ham1p_like domain (PF01725.22) spanning residues 3–187.
Shows 78.6% identity over 100% query and target coverage to reviewed Flavobacterium johnsoniae dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase A5FH89 (E-value 1.8e-107).
Strongly inferred to be a dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase, EC 3.6.1.66, likely acting as a homodimeric Mg2+-dependent enzyme.
Likely hydrolyzes noncanonical purine nucleotides dITP, ITP, and XTP to the corresponding monophosphates and diphosphate.
Likely biological role is nucleotide-pool sanitization, limiting incorporation of damaged or noncanonical purines into DNA/RNA.

entities.name: A5FH89
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Flavobacterium johnsoniae annotated as dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase.
Catalyzes hydrolysis of XTP, dITP, and ITP; binds one Mg2+ per subunit; forms a homodimer.
Annotated to cytosol and purine nucleoside triphosphate catabolic process.

entities.name: Ham1p-like domain PF01725
observations: Pfam PF01725.22 Ham1p_like domain detected in the query from residues 3–187 with i-Evalue 4.5e-65.
This domain is characteristic of the inferred dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase family.

entities.name: dITP hydrolysis
observations: Inferred reaction: dITP + H2O → dIMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28342.

entities.name: XTP hydrolysis
observations: Inferred reaction: XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28610.

entities.name: ITP hydrolysis
observations: Inferred reaction: ITP + H2O → IMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:29399.
